entities.summary: Amsterdam Exchange Bank, a political institution in Netherlands during The Dutch Golden Age (1630–1672). Grew from Dutch East India Company and Dutch East India Company (VOC) founded – first publicly traded company. Led to the emergence of Tulip Mania & the Commercial Republic and Glorious Revolution.
